acceptance_criteria: Expose a separate read-only versioned video feasibility probe; existing client-probe.v1 remains identical. Missing codec support fails without fallback or capture.
Accept only a closed hash-bound normalized silent 256x256 MP4 up to 1.5 MB, 2..120 frames at 12 Hz, explicit loop/hold_last and provenance classification; never load an external media URL.

Separate bounded single-loader/decoder ownership from existing 5 FPS avatar surface and immutable KI labels; session/generation/epoch/key checks, 2.5s controller watchdog and 30s lease stay unchanged.
Close/pause/revoke releases own video, URL, canvas and camera publication without affecting speech/screen, and late asynchronous completion never attaches a stale source.

Deterministic invalid-input, concurrent decoder, lifecycle, clock, cleanup and unsupported tests plus actual private receiver video/image switch and revocation; full npm run check in an isolated build, no serving/trust deployment.
